title: Lamb Iskender-Style Italian Koftas
description: A fusion twist on traditional Italian koftas, infused with the bold flavors of Turkish Iskender-style lamb.
instructions: In a large bowl, combine lamb, breadcrumbs, parsley, garlic, red pepper flakes, salt, and black pepper. Mix well with your hands until just combined.
Do not overmix. Cover the mixture and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes to allow the flavors to meld.
Thread the lamb mixture onto skewers, leaving a small space between each kofta.
Brush the grill with olive oil to prevent sticking.
Grill the koftas for 4-5 minutes per side, or until cooked through to an internal temperature of 63°C (145°F).
Transfer the koftas to a plate and let rest for 5 minutes before serving.
Serve hot with your favorite sides, such as pasta or a green salad.
